consolidation.statement: Implement a new gold-cycle diagnostic: pairwise rank-error correlation analysis across modules, per fusion task. One new function build_fusion_correlation_diagnostics(modules, train_years, eval_year) in a new file src/evo_predictor/gold_cycle/fusion_diagnostics.py. For each task, joins each module's event_level_metrics rows on (year, round_num), computes Pearson r of mean_absolute_rank_error series for every module pair, returns structured dict keyed by task then module-pair. Runner calls it and stores result in summary and detail. Schema updated. Reports renderer adds a correlation section. No fusion contract change. Triage candidate: if any module pair shows |r| > threshold, pre-draft and file a correction-phase issue.
consolidation.protected_intent: Diagnostic only — no fusion change this run. Correlation values drive a future decision, not an immediate one. Eval year excluded from correlation computation to avoid leakage.

triage_candidates.title: Fusion correlation correction
triage_candidates.description: If pairwise rank-error correlation diagnostic reveals any module pair with |r| > 0.6 for any task, file a follow-up issue for: evaluate de-weighting mechanism (covariance_tension_inflation or joint covariance), gate on held-out Brier improvement before merging fusion contract change.
triage_candidates.action: assess at triage step after diagnostic is implemented
